extracted.intended_audience: Catholic faithful and clergy preparing for or celebrating the Eucharist (devout laity and priests)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical and spiritual guidance for preparing to receive (and to celebrate, for priests) the Holy Communion: how to dispose the heart, moral requirements, frequency, preparation and aftercare, and pastoral obligations. Focused devotional instruction rather than liturgical law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wholehearted self-offering to God
rubrics_metrics.description: «Seigneur, à qui tout appartient ... je veux me donner à vous, par une oblation volontaire; je veux être à vous pour toujours.» — the disciple offers himself completely to God, to serve, obey, and immolate himself continually to God's glory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare the heart in simplicity and total surrender; present oneself as an oblation united to the Sacrifice of Christ so that the Eucharist bears fruit of salvation for oneself and the Church.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confess faults humbly and with contrition
rubrics_metrics.description: «Toutes les fautes et tous les crimes que j'ai commis ... je vous les offre ... afin que vous les consumiez par le feu de votre amour ... et me pardonnant tous pleinement» — one must confess all sins humbly, with bitter sorrow, and implore God's clemency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make a sincere confession, feel contrition, resolve not to sin again, and be ready to do penance and make satisfaction 'selon mon pouvoir'; do not delay confession when troubled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer prayers and Communion intentions for others
rubrics_metrics.description: «Je vous offre encore tous les pieux désirs des âmes fidèles, les besoins de mes parents ... de tous ceux qui me sont chers» — the faithful should offer the Mass and prayers for relatives, friends, benefactors, those who asked, the living and the dead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include intercession for family, friends, benefactors, petitioners, enemies and the whole human family so that the grace of the Sacrament benefits them; the priest covers humanity in his prayer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forgive others and remove bitterness from the heart
rubrics_metrics.description: «Ôtez de nos coeurs ... le soupçon, l'aigreur, la colère, tout ce qui divise» — the communicant must ask God to remove suspicion, bitterness, anger and anything that diminishes fraternal charity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek reconciliation and forgiveness before approaching Communion; eradicate dispositions that divide or impede charity, since mutual offenses should be forgiven to receive the Sacrament worthily.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priestly offering must be complete and without reserve
rubrics_metrics.description: «le prêtre ... doit s'offrir ainsi que Jésus-Christ s'est offert lui-même: leur sacrifice uni au sien doit être, comme le sien, sans réserve» — the priest must offer himself wholly when renewing the divine sacrifice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priests are called to reproduce Christ's self-offering, intercede for all, and unite their own suffering to Christ's Passion; the priest's interior self-gift is integral to the efficacious offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not easily abstain from Holy Communion; receive frequently
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il faut recourir souvent à la source de la grâce ... ne vous privez point de la sainte Communion» — faithful should frequently approach the Eucharist as the remedy for passions and vices and a source of strength.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid giving in to pretexts or timidity that keep one away; frequent reception fortifies the soul against temptation and spiritual lethargy; only legitimate reasons justify absence and even then maintain desire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reject scruples and satanic temptations about Communion
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il faut se rire avec mépris de cet esprit misérable, et n'abandonner jamais la sainte Communion, à cause de ses attaques et des mouvements qu'il excite en nous.» — satanic suggestions and scruples often attack just when one prepares to receive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not be paralyzed by shameful or horrible temptations or excessive anxieties; dismiss them, seek prudent counsel, and avoid letting scruples destroy piety.

rubrics_metrics.name: If legitimately prevented, preserve intention and make spiritual Communion
rubrics_metrics.description: «Que si des motifs légitimes l'empêchent ... il conservera toujours l'intention et le saint désir de communier ... il peut aussi communier en esprit tous les jours, à toute heure, avec beaucoup de fruit.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When prevented for legitimate causes, maintain the desire and intention to receive; practise meditation on the Incarnation and Passion and receive spiritual nourishment by prayer and reading Scripture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare by penance and steadfast practice of the virtues
rubrics_metrics.description: «La préparation ... comprendre deux choses: il faut purifier le Cénacle, et il faut l'orner ... lavée dans les eaux de la pénitence, et ensuite s'être exercée à la pratique des vertus» — purification by penance and exercise of virtues are required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparation requires sacramental confession, sincere humility, contempt of self, lively faith, perfect abandonment to God's will, detachment from earthly goods and the practice of charity as described in Corinthians (patience, humility, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain vigilance after Communion; avoid outward distraction
rubrics_metrics.description: «il faut encore travailler à vous y conserver après; et la vigilance qui la doit suivre n'est pas moins nécessaire que la préparation qui la précède ... Parlez peu, retirez-vous ... et jouissez de votre Dieu.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After receiving, remain recollected and silent, withdraw to private prayer, do not dissipate the grace by loquacity or worldly concerns; post-Communion vigilance fosters deeper union and future readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not prepare for Communion only at festivals; sustain habitual readiness
rubrics_metrics.description: «Celui qui ne se prépare à la Communion qu'aux approches des fêtes ... sera souvent mal préparé. Heureux celui qui s'offre au Seigneur en holocauste, toutes les fois qu'il célèbre le sacrifice...»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate habitual preparation so one could receive frequently; conform to regular use of community life (neither too slow nor too prompt) and consider the common good when choosing times to receive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scripture (the Word) and the Body of Christ are both necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: «Je sens que deux choses me sont ici-bas souverainement nécessaires ... votre chair sacrée ... et votre parole pour luire comme une lampe devant ses pas» — the faithful need both the Eucharist and Holy Scripture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regard the sacrament (table of the altar) and the Word (table of the law) as complementary treasures: the Body as food and the Word as light guiding the soul; both sustain the pilgrim life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priests must keep themselves holy in body and soul to handle the Sacrament
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il ne doit sortir rien que de saint, rien que d'honnête, rien que d'utile, de la bouche du prêtre ... Qu'ils soient simples et chastes les yeux ... pures et élevées au ciel, les mains qui touchent ...»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priests should cultivate purity of mouth, hands, eyes, body and soul because of their constant contact with the Author of purity; strive for innocence, confess sincerely, and renew the resolution to serve fervently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Desire intimate union with Christ; detach from creatures
rubrics_metrics.description: «Que le fidèle doit désirer de tout son coeur de s'unir à Jésus-Christ ... que mon coeur se détache de toutes les choses créées, et que, par la sainte Communion ... j'apprenne à goûter les choses du ciel»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrust oneself wholly to God (unity of will, abandonment to decrees, desire for inalterable union) and aim to be absorbed in God through reception of Communion, detachment, and continuous longing for divine presence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fervent devotion and tears are signs of Christ's presence in the sacrament
rubrics_metrics.description: «Ces âmes fidèles ... s'approchent ... d'y porter un coeur si aride, si tiède ... ils ne sauraient retenir leurs larmes, tant le désir ... est grand ... Ils ont soif de vous, ô mon Dieu ...» — intense thirst and tears accompany some devout souls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fervent, tearful devotion is presented as evidence of a living faith and awareness of Christ's real presence; believers should pray for such grace and imitate those holy examples, while trusting God to grant this fervor.
